summary: Iter 264 backend-only verification: consolidation of client-facing emails on public POST /api/leads/submit to exactly ONE (sendInquiryAcknowledgementEmail with enriched summary card). 9/9 pytest tests passed after backend restart. Code-level: 0 refs to sendClientConfirmation in backend/src (grep -rn); /submit block (leads.ts:461-615) contains only sendNewLeadNotification + sendInquiryAcknowledgementEmail; enrichment params (serviceLabel, budget, timeline, portfolioUrl, SERVICE_TYPE_LABELS) present; email.ts template has summaryCardHtml, portfolioLinkHtml, 'Your Inquiry' markup; SERVICE_TYPE_LABELS exported. Runtime: POST /api/leads/submit → 201 with exactly ONE '[EMAIL] Inquiry acknowledgement (sent to|failed)' log line and ZERO occurrences of 'Failed to send client confirmation' / 'Client confirmation' / '[AutoResponse]' / 'Error sending auto-response' / 'Auto-response sent' in the request's log window. Regression: authenticated POST /api/leads still 201 and still triggers 'Error sending auto-response' log (call site at leads.ts:446 preserved). Baselines: login (200), GET /api/leads (200), backend boots clean.

minor.issue: Non-blocking Resend 403 'validation_error' in backend.err.log — RESEND_API_KEY set but domain unverified. Endpoints still return 201 because email sends are fire-and-forget with .catch handlers. Pre-existing env constraint, not a regression.

In authenticated POST /api/leads, the fallback error log for sendAutoResponse writes 'Error sending auto-response:' (from email.ts:1475) rather than the routes.ts wrapper's '[AutoResponse] Error:'. Not a bug, but the two log prefixes are inconsistent — makes greppability slightly harder. Cosmetic.

action_items: IMPORTANT deployment note for main agent: the running ts-node backend (started with `npx ts-node --transpile-only src/server.ts`, NO nodemon) does NOT auto-reload on source changes. When leads.ts was modified at 09:28 but backend had started at 09:25, the pre-fix code kept executing and produced 3 client emails per /submit. I ran `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` and the fix immediately took effect. Any future source edits require an explicit backend restart to be verifiable — consider switching the supervisor command to `nodemon src/server.ts` for dev.

Optional cleanup: /app/kolor-studio-v2/backend/dist/ still contains stale compiled JS with the deleted sendClientConfirmation function (dist/services/email.js:320). Runtime is not affected (backend runs from src/ via ts-node), but the stale dist should be regenerated or gitignored to avoid confusion.

rca_of_issue: Initial test run showed 3 client emails per /submit (Failed to send client confirmation + Inquiry acknowledgement failed + Error sending auto-response × 2). Grep of backend/src returned 0 hits for sendClientConfirmation — proving source WAS clean. Comparing mtimes: leads.ts modified 09:28:06, backend process uptime 5m45s ⇒ started ~09:25. Backend runs `npx ts-node --transpile-only src/server.ts` with NO nodemon — no hot reload. Pre-fix code was cached in-memory. Fix: `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`, then re-ran tests — all 9 passed, /submit now logs exactly one '[EMAIL] Inquiry acknowledgement' line and zero deleted-path lines. Bug fix code is correct; the runtime just needed a restart to load it.
